title: Simulation of a valid nested-pair input
statement: Let $A$ be a register-program instruction map, let $l_0,l,l'$ be program states, let $r$ be a register, and suppose the instruction at $l$ validates a nested pair using register $r$, with successor $l'$. For any oracle, register values $v$, output word, and integer $W\ge 0$, if the input encodes a unary prefix paired with two nested payloads, each canonical (every nonempty payload ends in $1$), the program simulates from the initial configuration with state $l$ to the corresponding configuration with state $l'$; otherwise it halts with answer false.
hypotheses_covered: Instruction map $A$ and initial program state $l_0$
The instruction at $l$ is the specified nested-pair validation instruction
Validity or invalidity of the input
